lore.syncretism: Jagannātha appears within the Sanskrit tradition and has influenced later retellings, artistic depictions, and scholarly study. The Unicode restoration preserves the name's distinctive orthography for contemporary use.
lore.culturalLegacy: Jagannātha continues to appear in scholarship, art, and popular reception as a significant figure of the Sanskrit tradition. Restoring the name in Unicode returns the original marks that ASCII removes.
lore.extendedMeditation: Jagannātha embodies lord of the world, puri, devotion in the Sanskrit imagination. The name's restoration is not merely cosmetic: it recovers the stress, length, and script that make the figure recognizable in the source tradition.
lore.archaeology: Jagannātha is attested in the textual and iconographic record of the Sanskrit tradition.
